'''Bpfasshi''' were [[near-Human]]s native to [[Bpfassh]].

==History==
{{Quote|The Bpfasshi don't like Jedi. They had some trouble with Dark Jedi during the Clone Wars, and chased them as far as Dagobah.|Leia Organa Solo, to Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Heir to the Empire 2">[[Heir to the Empire 2|''Heir to the Empire'' 2]]</ref>}}
[[File:Bpfasshi.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Bpfasshi [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] cult [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader|leader]].]]

In [[700 BBY]], a cult of Bpfasshi [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] tried to establish themselves throughout the [[Bpfassh system/Legends|Bpfassh system]]. A [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] task force engaged and killed them, with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Minch (Jedi)|Minch]] killing their [[Bpfasshi Dark Jedi leader|leader]] on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]].<ref name="HOD">{{Tales|16|Heart of Darkness}}</ref>

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], another group of Bpfasshi Dark Jedi were responsible for a [[Bpfassh Uprising|rampage of terror and destruction]] throughout the [[Sluis sector/Legends|Sluis sector]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] sent a task force led by [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to stop them and quell the insurrection in the Bpfassh system.<ref name="HTTE" /> Yoda pursued and killed one of the Dark Jedi that had kidnapped [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Jorj Car'das]].<ref name="VOTF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref> The Bpfasshi maintained a strong disliking for all Jedi since those events.<ref name="HTTE" />

Despite this earlier hostility, the Bpfasshi joined the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], which was allied with the [[New Jedi Order]].
